  70| /**
  71|  * /sms/rest/v2/otp API error codes
  72|  * @enum {string}
  73|  */
  74| export enum SendOtpSmsErrorCode {
  75|   /** Operation successful */
  76|   SUCCESS = "00",
  77|   /** Could not be sent due to a problem in the message text or exceeded the standard maximum message character count */
  78|   MESSAGE_TEXT_ERROR = "20",
  79|   /** Invalid username, password or no API access. If IP restriction exists, request may have been made from an unauthorized IP */
  80|   INVALID_AUTH = "30",
  81|   /** Message header (sender name) is not defined in the system */
  82|   UNDEFINED_HEADER = "40",
  83|   /** Message header (sender name) is not valid in the system */
  84|   INVALID_HEADER = "41",
  85|   /** Check for Number */
  86|   CHECK_NUMBER_50 = "50",
  87|   /** Check for Number */
  88|   CHECK_NUMBER_51 = "51",
  89|   /** Check for Number */
  90|   CHECK_NUMBER_52 = "52",
  91|   /** No Credit for OTP */
  92|   NO_CREDIT = "60",
  93|   /** Invalid query. One of the parameters is incorrect or a required field is missing */
  94|   PARAMETER_ERROR = "70",
  95|   /** System error */
  96|   SYSTEM_ERROR_100 = "100",
  97|   /** System error */
  98|   SYSTEM_ERROR_101 = "101",
  99|   /** Undefined error */
 100|   UNDEFINED_ERROR = "5000",
 101| }

== src/netgsm.ts lines 34-52 (file sha256 6c9f071a8b13ea39fcff56a482162775b1b47715dc32c3fc0b228851d1053edc)
  34| 
  35| /**
  36|  * Validates if a code exists in an enum, returns "5000" if not found
  37|  * @param code - The code to validate
  38|  * @param enumObj - The enum object to check against (optional)
  39|  * @returns Valid code or "5000" for undefined errors
  40|  */
  41| function normalizeErrorCode(code: string | undefined | null, enumObj?: object): string {
  42|   if (!code || typeof code !== "string") {
  43|     return "5000";
  44|   }
  45| 
  46|   // If enum provided, check if code exists in enum values
  47|   if (enumObj && !Object.values(enumObj).includes(code)) {
  48|     return "5000";
  49|   }
  50| 
  51|   return code;
  52| }

== src/netgsm.ts lines 128-150 (file sha256 6c9f071a8b13ea39fcff56a482162775b1b47715dc32c3fc0b228851d1053edc)
 128|   /**
 129|    * Send OTP SMS using REST v2 API
 130|    * @param {OtpSmsPayload} payload - JSON payload for sending OTP SMS.
 131|    * @returns {Promise<OtpSmsResponse>} - The API response.
 132|    */
 133|   async sendOtpSms(payload: OtpSmsPayload): Promise<OtpSmsResponse> {
 134|     const response = await fetch(`${this.baseURL}/sms/rest/v2/otp`, {
 135|       method: "POST",
 136|       headers: this.headers,
 137|       body: JSON.stringify({
 138|         msgheader: payload.msgheader,
 139|         ...(payload?.appname
 140|           ? { appname: payload.appname }
 141|           : this.sdkAppName
 142|             ? { appname: this.sdkAppName }
 143|             : {}),
 144|         msg: payload.msg,
 145|         no: payload.no,
 146|       }),
 147|     });
 148| 
 149|     return await this.handleResponse<OtpSmsResponse>(response, SendOtpSmsErrorCode);
 150|   }

== src/netgsm.ts lines 296-342 (file sha256 6c9f071a8b13ea39fcff56a482162775b1b47715dc32c3fc0b228851d1053edc)
 296|   private async handleResponse<T>(response: Response, errorCodeEnum?: object): Promise<T> {
 297|     // Try to parse JSON response
 298|     let data;
 299|     try {
 300|       data = await response.json();
 301|     } catch (error) {
 302|       // If JSON parsing fails, throw HTTP error
 303|       throw {
 304|         status: response.status,
 305|         code: "PARSE_ERROR",
 306|         description: `Failed to parse JSON response: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error"}`,
 307|       };
 308|     }
 309| 
 310|     // Check if response is success status
 311|     if (response.status === 200 || response.status === 406) {
 312|       // Validate data structure
 313|       if (typeof data !== "object" || data === null) {
 314|         throw {
 315|           status: response.status,
 316|           code: "INVALID_RESPONSE",
 317|           description: "Response is not a valid object",
 318|         };
 319|       }
 320| 
 321|       // Normalize error code - if code is missing or not in enum, set to "5000"
 322|       data.code = normalizeErrorCode(data.code, errorCodeEnum);
 323| 
 324|       // Check if API returned an error code
 325|       if (data.code !== "00") {
 326|         throw {
 327|           status: response.status !== 200 ? response.status : 406,
 328|           ...data,
 329|         };
 330|       }
 331| 
 332|       // Success case
 333|       return data as T;
 334|     }
 335| 
 336|     // HTTP error cases (non-200/406 status codes)
 337|     throw {
 338|       status: response.status,
 339|       code: normalizeErrorCode(data?.code, errorCodeEnum) || response.statusText,
 340|       description: data?.description || "HTTP Error",
 341|     };
 342|   }

 233|   // 8. OTP SMS gönderimi
 234|   it("should send OTP SMS", async () => {

 236|       msgheader: process.env.NETGSM_MESSAGE_HEADER || "TEST",
 237|       msg: "OTP test mesajı",
 238|       no: process.env.TEST_PHONE_NUMBER || "",
